title: Widgets API - How to edit widgets data with API Calls
text:
## Widgets API - How to edit widgets data with API Calls
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103396
The API allows getting, creating, updating, deleting, rendering, and posting widgets on the website. However, only one widget can be updated at a time.

## Available API Endpoints
Below is a list of the available endpoints for Widgets:
https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/get/{id}
https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/create
https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/update
https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/delete
https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/render
Using the API, the following actions can be performed:

## Get a Widget
Read the data of a single widget based on the widget_id.
The Default widgets included in a /get list response are limited to those supported by the current version of the software. Default widgets that belong only to legacy versions are no longer included, so API responses may contain fewer widgets than in previous versions. This is expected and does not affect the Widget Manager or any existing website.
Widgets that support the current version along with older versions are still returned. The filter checks whether the current version is included in the widget's supported versions, not whether it is the only supported version. Customized widgets are also returned regardless of the versions they list, and reading a single widget by its widget_id is not filtered.

Example Request:
Query Parameters:
property The property key (eg., widget_id). property_value The value associated with the property.
